rows: Multiple tuning systems (12-TET, 24-TET, just, Pythagorean) with zero runtime dependencies. Useful for the Chinese-vs-Western comparison, but `just_intonation` covers the SUN core and aulos is under development with a changing API.

Supports the full range of regular temperaments, explicitly for Byzantine, Renaissance, Indian classical, gamelan, Arabic Maqam. Genuinely relevant to the parallel-tradition problem, but heavy for what SOL currently does. Would matter if SOL moves to explicit multi-tradition tuning comparison.
Cube face/incidence enumeration. The cube result was already computed manually; Sage would formalize it but not change it.
Comparative mythology datasets. Larger than needed and less source-traceable than deitydb. Redundant.
